text.Sana uygun kredi kartını bul, kampanyala: Find the credit card that suits you, compare campaigns and calculate when your card debt will be paid off, taxes included.
text.Limit ihtiyacına, harcama alışkanlığına: Compare cards by your limit needs, spending habits and campaigns, and apply with a single form.
text.Faizsiz nakit avans ve taksit kampanyala: Interest-free cash advance and installment campaigns
text.Gelirine uygun limit seçenekleri: Limit options that match your income
text.Kart borcunu kapatma planı: A plan to pay off your card debt
text.Kart borcun ne zaman biter?: When will your card debt be paid off?
text.Aylık ödemen faizi karşılamıyor; borç bu: Your monthly payment doesn't cover the interest; the debt won't be paid off with this payment.
text.Hesaplamada faize KKDF (%15) ve BSMV (%1: The calculation adds KKDF (Resource Utilization Support Fund, 15%) and BSMV (Banking and Insurance Transaction Tax, 15%) to the interest. You can find your current contractual interest rate on your card statement.
text.Kredi kartıyla neler yapabilirsin?: What can you do with a credit card?
text.Kampanya dönemlerinde nakit ihtiyacını f: Cover your cash needs with interest-free installments during campaign periods.
text.Büyük harcamaları bütçeni zorlamadan tak: Split big purchases into installments without straining your budget.
text.Harcamalarından puan kazan, anlaşmalı iş: Earn points on your spending and get discounts at partner merchants.
text.İnternet alışverişlerinde sanal kart, ma: Use a virtual card for online shopping and contactless payment in stores.
text.İhtiyacına göre kart seç: Choose a card that fits your needs
text.Her kart türü farklı bir kullanım için t: Each card type is designed for a different use. Choose the one that best fits your spending habits.
text.Günlük harcamalar, taksit ve nakit avans: A basic card for everyday spending, installments and cash advances. Usually available with no annual fee.
text.Daha yüksek limit, ek puan kampanyaları: Offers a higher limit, bonus point campaigns and extra perks such as travel insurance.
text.Havalimanı lounge erişimi, concierge ve: For frequent travelers, with airport lounge access, concierge service and hotel privileges.
text.Şirket harcamalarını ayırmak, vadeli alı: For separating company expenses, making deferred-payment purchases and tracking costs.
text.Ana kartından bağımsız limitle güvenli i: Lets you shop online securely with a limit separate from your main card.
text.Ana kartının limitini aile bireylerinle: Lets you share your main card's limit with family members and see all spending on a single statement.
text.Kredi kartı başvurusu nasıl yapılır?: How do you apply for a credit card?
text.Kredi kartı başvurusu hem online hem de: You can easily apply for a credit card either online or at bank branches. During the application, you may be asked for your Turkish ID Number, mobile phone number, personal details, employer details and income information. Your income information is important for determining your card limit.
text.Başvurunun onaylanması için 18 yaşını do: For your application to be approved, you must be at least 18 years old, declare a regular income and have a sufficient credit score. Your credit score is one of the most important factors banks consider when evaluating you.
text.Banka limitini gelirine, kredi notuna ve: The bank sets your limit based on your income, credit score and existing debts. By law, the total limit of all your cards cannot exceed 2 times your monthly income in the first year, and 4 times in subsequent years.
text.Dönem borcunun tamamını ödemek faiz ödem: Paying your full statement balance is the easiest way to avoid paying interest. If you pay only the minimum amount, contractual interest accrues on the remaining debt. Failing to pay the minimum amount three times within a year may result in your card being closed to cash use.
text.Kredi Kartı Başvurusu için 5 Önemli Adım: 5 Key Steps for a Credit Card Application
text.Yaş ve gelir şartlarını karşıla: Meet the age and income requirements
text.Kredi kartı başvurusu için hangi şartlar: What are the requirements for a credit card application?
text.18 yaşını doldurmuş olmak, düzenli bir g: You must be at least 18 years old, declare a regular income and have a sufficient credit score. The application asks for your Turkish ID Number, contact details and income information.
text.Kart limitim nasıl belirlenir?: How is my card limit determined?
text.Limit; gelirine, kredi notuna ve mevcut: Your limit is set by the bank based on your income, credit score and existing debts. By law, the total limit of all your cards cannot exceed 2 times your monthly income in the first year, and 4 times in subsequent years.
text.Akdi faiz ve gecikme faizi nedir?: What are contractual interest and late payment interest?
text.Akdi faiz, dönem borcunun ödenmeyen kısm: Contractual interest is the interest charged on the unpaid portion of your statement balance. Late payment interest applies when you pay less than the minimum payment amount. Neither rate can exceed the maximum rates set by the Central Bank; KKDF and BSMV are also added to the interest.
text.Asgari ödeme yaparsam ne olur?: What happens if I make the minimum payment?
text.Asgari tutarı ödersen gecikmeye düşmezsi: If you pay the minimum amount, you won't fall into arrears, but contractual interest accrues on the remaining debt and it takes longer to pay off. With the calculator, you can see when your debt will be paid off at different payment amounts.
text.Başvurumun sonucu ne zaman belli olur?: When will I know the result of my application?
text.Süre bankaya göre değişir. Başvurunun so: The time varies by bank. The result of your application is usually sent by SMS; an approved card is delivered to your address.
text.Kimlik bilgilerinle tek formda başvur; ü: Apply with your ID details in a single form; if you're a member, track your application under My Account > My Applications.
